text: That is good news regarding your clotting profile. To narrow down the cause of your sudden onset pain, have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or changes in your bowel habits like constipation or diarrhea? REQUEST TEST: Amylase_and_Lipase

speaker: Doctor
text: Excellent, normal amylase and lipase levels make pancreatitis unlikely. To further differentiate between biliary issues or bowel pathology, have you noticed any jaundice, fever, or specifically, has the pain radiated to your right shoulder or back? REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests

speaker: Doctor
text: Normal liver function rules out significant biliary obstruction or hepatitis. Have you noticed any recent weight loss, night sweats, or a change in your bowel habits such as greasy stools or blood in the stool?
